pll1d35c1-d1e3501.summary: Announces special treatment of some substantial attributes: knowledge, foreknowledge, providence, disposition, predestination, will, and power.

pll1d35c1-d1e3504.summary: States that God's wisdom or knowledge, one and simple, takes many names because of various states of things and effects: foreknowledge, disposition, predestination, providence.
claims: God's knowledge is one and simple.
It is named differently according to its objects and effects.

pl-l1d35c1.summary: Turns to attributes said of God by substance that require special treatment: knowledge, foreknowledge, providence, disposition, predestination, will, and power. God's wisdom or knowledge, though one and simple, receives many names because of the various states of things and effects: knowledge, foreknowledge, disposition, predestination, providence.
claims: Knowledge, foreknowledge, providence, disposition, predestination, will, and power need special treatment.
God's knowledge is one and simple.
It receives different names according to the different states of things and effects.
